subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should OpenClaw land this focused fresh-session recook fallback for accepted gateway disconnects now, or hold it for the reattach-first design tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes a real same-session corruption path, but it deliberately preserves a second local execution after the gateway accepted the original run; only maintainers can accept that user-visible fallback boundary.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect, merge the same-session protection, and leave reattach-first behavior to the linked follow-up issue.

options.title: Fold into reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR and require the branch to recover the accepted gateway run before any local recook path is used.

options.title: Reject local recook after acceptance
options.body: Close or redesign this PR if maintainers decide accepted gateway disconnects must never start a second local model/tool run.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect, merge the same-session protection, and leave reattach-first behavior to the linked follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the adjacent accepted-run abort and restart-recovery work and is the clearest routing candidate for the fallback product boundary.
